title: the staged-format guard reports a file its Elixir or Markdown formatter cannot parse as not formatted, where Rust says it could not be checked
body:
Found by dc on 2026-09-24 in the 3.2.1 doc audit, driven in a scratch project on the pair at `4c687eaad`.

Seen: the staged-format guard reports an Elixir or Markdown file its formatter cannot parse as "not formatted" (`staged-format-guard.sh:204-206`, `:229-231`). Only Rust keeps its "could not be checked" line (`:332-341`), although the file's header claims that distinction for every formatter. Driven: an unclosed `(` in a staged `.ex` was refused as "elixir is not formatted".

Expected: a file the formatter cannot parse is reported as unchecked, for every formatter the guard runs.

Disposition: vc, 2026-09-24 -- filed for after the stabilisation line; the commit is still refused, and `intent/docs/pre-commit-hook.md` describes the as-built wording.


Fixed in 3.2.2 by `6ac984ae6` (vc, 2026-09-25): the commit message names the bank, its patch-id and the judge.
